title: How Much Fiber in Quinoa? 5.2g per Cup
description: Quinoa: about 5.2 g of fiber per 1 cup, cooked (19% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in quinoa?
intro: Quinoa ranks #4 of 8 grains on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in quinoa by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in quinoa?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists quinoa, cooked at 2.8 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 cup, cooked; 185 g) therefore has about 5.2 g of fiber and 222 calories. That is 19% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 21% of a 25 g day and 14% of a 38 g day.
Quinoa is a seed cooked like a grain. It has more fiber per cooked cup than white or brown rice, and it cooks in about 15 minutes, which is why it often replaces rice in bowls and salads.

sections.heading: Dry vs cooked quinoa
paragraphs: Quinoa roughly triples in volume as it cooks, so a quarter cup of dry quinoa makes about three-quarters of a cup cooked. Log the dry amount if you measure before cooking, or cooked if you scoop from the pot, but not both.
Rinsing removes the bitter saponin coating. It does not affect fiber.

sections.heading: How quinoa compares with other grains
paragraphs: Of the 8 grains on this site, quinoa ranks #4 for fiber per typical serving and #7 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 2.3 g of fiber per 100 calories, in the middle of the range for the foods on this site.

Close neighbors by serving: [whole wheat pasta](/fiber-in-whole-wheat-pasta) at 5.5 g (1 cup spaghetti, cooked); [barley](/fiber-in-barley) at 6 g (1 cup, cooked (pearled)); [popcorn](/fiber-in-popcorn) at 3.6 g (3 cups, air-popped). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), quinoa is #42 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding quinoa to your day
paragraphs: Swap rice for quinoa in a bowl and add beans or vegetables on top. Quinoa alone is a moderate fiber source; combined with half a cup of beans it becomes a high-fiber meal.

Example: 1 cup quinoa, 1/2 cup black beans, 1 cup broccoli. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 17.8 g of fiber, with 5.2 g from the quinoa. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of quinoa?
faqs.a: 2.8 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Quinoa, cooked). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in quinoa (1/2 cup, cooked)?
faqs.a: About 2.6 g, for 92.5 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.

faqs.q: Quinoa vs brown rice: which has more fiber?
faqs.a: Quinoa. Cooked quinoa is about 5.2 g (1 cup, cooked); cooked brown rice is about 3.2 g (1 cup, cooked).
Quinoa itself does not contain gluten. If you need to avoid gluten strictly, look for products labeled gluten-free, since cross-contact can happen during processing.
